Upgrade your daily drive with this Blue Certified 2019 Nissan Altima 2.5 Platinum AWD at Franklin Ford in Franklin, Massachusetts. With 89,546 miles, stock #SL0503A combines a red exterior, a well-equipped Platinum cabin and Nissan Intelligent All-Wheel Drive. This five-passenger sedan brings together comfort, connected technology and useful driver-assistance features for commuting, local errands and weekend travel throughout New England.

Under the hood, a 2.5-liter direct-injection four-cylinder engine delivers 182 horsepower in this AWD configuration and is paired with Nissan's Xtronic continuously variable transmission. Intelligent All-Wheel Drive can distribute power between the front and rear wheels as conditions demand, adding traction support when you need it. The 2019 Altima 2.5 Platinum AWD carries EPA estimates of 25 MPG city, 35 MPG highway and 29 MPG combined. Actual fuel economy varies with driving conditions and vehicle use.

The Platinum trim makes everyday comfort a priority. Standard equipment includes leather-appointed seats, heated front seats, a heated leather-wrapped steering wheel and an 8-way power driver's seat with power lumbar support. Driver-seat memory helps you return to your preferred position, and a 4-way power front-passenger seat adds flexibility. Dual-zone automatic temperature control and rear air vents help keep the cabin comfortable, while the power sliding glass moonroof brings in fresh air and natural light.

NissanConnect features an 8-inch touchscreen with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto for compatible smartphones. Built-in navigation, Bluetooth hands-free calling and streaming audio make it easier to stay connected on the road. The Bose Premium Audio System includes nine speakers. USB ports help keep compatible devices charged. A 7-inch Advanced Drive-Assist Display puts useful information ahead of the driver. Satellite radio and connected services require applicable subscriptions and service availability.

Platinum's standard Intelligent Around View Monitor provides a composite overhead view to help with low-speed maneuvering. ProPILOT Assist combines steering assistance and Intelligent Cruise Control to support the driver in suitable highway conditions. Additional factory driver-assistance features include Automatic Emergency Braking with Pedestrian Detection, Blind Spot Warning, Rear Cross Traffic Alert, Rear Automatic Braking and Intelligent Lane Intervention. These systems have operating limits and do not replace attentive driving, keep your hands on the wheel and remain responsible for the vehicle at all times.

Nissan Intelligent Key with push-button ignition, remote engine start with Intelligent Climate Control, an auto-dimming rearview mirror and a HomeLink universal transceiver add thoughtful conveniences. The 60/40 split-folding rear seat helps accommodate longer cargo. Platinum exterior equipment includes 19-inch aluminum-alloy wheels, LED headlights, LED fog lights and heated outside mirrors with integrated turn signals. Interior accent lighting and wood-tone trim give the cabin a polished finish.

Ford Blue Advantage Blue Certified benefits include a 139-point inspection and Ford-backed 3-month/4,000-mile Comprehensive Limited Warranty coverage, whichever comes first. Complimentary 24/7 Roadside Assistance is included for 90 days. For this Nissan, the limited warranty begins on the purchase signature date at the vehicle's mileage at purchase. Coverage is subject to program terms, exclusions and a deductible. Ask Franklin Ford for complete certification and limited-warranty details.

description: ATHLETIC, SHARP-DRESSED, ALL-WEATHER CONFIDENT, NONSMOKER, SPORT SEDAN SWAGGER! The 2019 Acura TLX A-Spec takes the brand's well-rounded luxury sedan and gives it a sharper suit and a more focused attitude. This example pairs the top-tier 3.5-liter V6 with Acura's celebrated Super Handling All-Wheel Drive, finished in deep Still Night Pearl over a bold red leather interior. That red cabin is the first thing most people notice, and it sets the tone for the whole car: sporty, confident, and anything but anonymous. Behind it sits the most desirable mechanical combination the TLX offered. A 290-horsepower V6, a nine-speed automatic transmission, and SH-AWD together deliver strong acceleration with real all-season traction. SH-AWD is more than a foul-weather safety net. Rather than simply reacting to wheel slip, Acura's system actively distributes torque between the front and rear axles, and between the left and right rear wheels, helping the sedan rotate eagerly into corners while staying planted on rain-slicked or snowy roads. It is a big part of why enthusiasts specifically seek out SH-AWD versions of the TLX. Why Shoppers Buy This Model Acura introduced the TLX in 2015 to replace both the TL and TSX sedans, combining the best of each into one midsize luxury sport sedan. Shoppers choose it because it delivers much of the comfort, technology, and performance of German rivals such as the BMW 3 Series and Audi A4, backed by Acura's reputation for durable engineering and sensible ownership costs. The TLX also stands out for how much it includes. Driver-assistance technology, Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, and a long list of comfort features came standard. That generosity, paired with a smooth, quiet ride and strong engine choices, made the TLX a compelling, value-driven alternative for buyers who want premium polish without premium headaches. Automotive Press and Industry Recognition Reviewers consistently credited the TLX with a strong V6, a genuinely sporty A-Spec variant, and the impressive cornering composure of its available SH-AWD system. They also praised its smooth, refined, and comfortably quiet ride on almost any road surface. Federal testers backed up its safety credentials, awarding the 2019 TLX a FIVE-STAR OVERALL SAFETY RATING from NHTSA, along with five-star frontal and side impact results. Warranty This TLX shows exactly 117,178 miles on the odometer. Measured from an estimated in-service date of February 2019, it is beyond both the time and mileage limits of Acura's original factory warranty coverage, so that original factory coverage has expired. Spread across more than seven and a half years, that mileage works out to roughly 15,000 miles per year, right in line with typical commuting use. Service records show regular maintenance throughout its life, including oil and filter changes, tire rotations, and front brake pad replacement in its earlier years. Later, at an Acura dealership, it received a transmission fluid change and differential fluid service, both important maintenance items for a V6 SH-AWD drivetrain. Extended service plans may be available for buyers who want added peace of mind. Standard Features The A-Spec configuration is the TLX for drivers who want their luxury sedan to look and feel sportier. A-Spec models wear a darkened exterior treatment with unique front and rear fascias, a lip spoiler, larger round exhaust finishers, 19'' wheels, and A-Spec badging. Inside, they add sport seats trimmed in leather, with this example finished in striking red. On SH-AWD V6 models, the A-Spec also brings a quicker steering ratio for sharper, more immediate response. Its standard equipment adds heated and ventilated front seats, the 10-speaker ELS Studio premium audio system, Acura Navigation with real-time traffic, and blind spot and rear cross traffic monitoring with front and rear parking sensors. The result is a TLX that is both the most engaging and one of the best-equipped versions of the model. Mechanical Features The 3.5-liter i-VTEC V6 produces 290 horsepower and 267 lb-ft of torque, delivering the smooth, linear, eager-to-rev character that has made Acura's V6 engines so well liked. It pulls cleanly from low speeds and feels especially satisfying as it climbs toward its upper rev range, with a distinctive, sporty intake note. A nine-speed automatic transmission keeps the engine in its sweet spot, relaxing at highway speeds and responding quickly when you call for passing power. Acura's Integrated Dynamics System lets you choose between Econ, Normal, Sport, and Sport+ modes, adjusting throttle, steering, and shift behavior to match your mood. With SH-AWD actively managing torque at all four corners, this TLX feels confident and secure in every season while rewarding a spirited drive on a winding road. Exterior Features Still Night Pearl is a deep, rich blue that can read nearly black in shadow and comes alive in sunlight, and it suits the A-Spec's darkened trim perfectly. The look is purposeful and understated rather than flashy, with the dark grille, sculpted fascias, and lip spoiler giving the TLX a lower, more athletic stance. Acura's signature LED headlights with automatic high beams provide crisp, bright illumination and a distinctive face, while the front fog lamps add visibility in poor weather. The 19'' A-Spec wheels fill out the fenders nicely, and the power sunroof brings fresh air and natural light into the cabin. Interior Features The red leather-trimmed sport seats make this TLX's cabin unmistakable, adding real warmth and personality to an otherwise clean, driver-focused layout. The seats are wide, well bolstered, and supportive when the road turns curvy, and the power-adjustable driver's seat makes it easy to find a comfortable position. Heated and ventilated front seats keep both front occupants comfortable in any season, and multi-zone automatic climate control helps everyone stay comfortable. A 60/40 split-folding rear seatback adds practical flexibility when you need to carry longer items from the trunk, and generous storage throughout the console and door bins keeps daily essentials organized. Infotainment & Technology Acura's dual-screen infotainment layout separates navigation from audio and vehicle controls, so key information stays visible while you adjust settings. Apple CarPlay and Android Auto bring your favorite apps, music, and messages onto the screen, while Bluetooth HandsFreeLink keeps calls convenient. The Acura Navigation System with 3D view includes AcuraLink real-time traffic and rerouting, and the 10-speaker ELS Studio premium audio system delivers rich, clear sound engineered specifically for this cabin. HomeLink and an auto-dimming rearview mirror round out the everyday conveniences. Subscription may be required to maintain service. Safety Features This TLX includes Adaptive Cruise Control with Low-Speed Follow, which maintains a set following distance and makes stop-and-go traffic far less tiring. The Collision Mitigation Braking System and Lane Keeping Assist add an attentive layer of protection on busy highways. Blind spot information and rear cross traffic monitoring help with lane changes and backing out of crowded spaces, while front and rear parking sensors and a rearview camera make tight parking easier. A comprehensive airbag system, including a driver's knee airbag, completes a well-rounded safety package. ... and there's SO MUCH more! If available, vehicle files can be found above this description on our website, including the original brochure and window sticker! The Bottom Line This is the TLX enthusiasts hunt for: the 290-horsepower V6 paired with SH-AWD, wrapped in A-Spec styling and finished in a striking Still Night Pearl and red leather combination. Its maintenance history includes the transmission and differential fluid services this drivetrain appreciates, and it delivers the all-season confidence, everyday comfort, and generous features that made the TLX such a strong value. It offers far more personality than the typical midsize luxury sedan. Red leather, a silky V6, and all-wheel-drive grip -- this TLX makes every commute feel like the long way home. We will happily evaluate your TRADE-IN and offer EXCELLENT FINANCE OPTIONS as well, so please give us a call at 732-919-0707 (Wall Township) or 856-881-2869 (Sewell) TODAY!

- 2.5L I4 engine producing 191 horsepower with 6-speed automatic transmission and AWD capability
- MAZDA CONNECT Infotainment System with AM/FM/HD Audio and radio data system
- 8-speaker audio system with steering wheel mounted audio controls
- Heated front sport bucket seats with leather trim and power driver seat with memory
- Power moonroof with elegant glass opening
- 18-inch aluminum alloy wheels
- Automatic temperature control with front dual zone A/C
- Fully automatic headlights with delay-off and auto high-beam functionality
- Exterior parking camera with rear view display
- Leather steering wheel and leather shift knob
- Electronic stability control, traction control, and brake assist
- Speed-sensing steering and power steering
- Emergency communication system with Mazda Connected Services (3-year complimentary trial)
- Rain sensing wipers with variably intermittent operation

This Mazda3 achieves 26 mpg in the city and 35 mpg on the highway, balancing responsive performance with practical fuel efficiency for your daily drives and weekend excursions. The all-wheel drive system provides enhanced traction and stability across varying road conditions, while the responsive 2.5-liter engine offers the confidence and capability you need for commutes and longer journeys alike.

Inside, you'll find a cabin thoughtfully designed for comfort and connectivity. The heated front sport bucket seats wrapped in leather provide support for every drive, complemented by power driver seat adjustments and memory function to personalize your position. The power moonroof floods the interior with natural light, creating an open and airy atmosphere. Climate zones in the front allow individual temperature preferences, ensuring everyone rides comfortably regardless of season.

Technology is seamlessly integrated throughout the cabin. The MAZDA CONNECT Infotainment System keeps you connected with an intuitive interface, while the 8-speaker audio system delivers clear sound quality enhanced by steering wheel mounted controls that let you manage entertainment without taking your hands off the road. The fully automatic headlights adapt to changing light conditions, and rain sensing wipers respond to weather for uninterrupted visibility.

Safety is engineered into every element of this vehicle. Multiple airbags including dual front impact, front side impact, knee, overhead, and rear side impact airbags work in concert with electronic stability control and traction control to help protect you and your passengers. The rear parking camera assists with low-speed maneuvering, while low tire pressure warning helps maintain proper vehicle maintenance. Brake assist and four-wheel disc brakes with ABS provide responsive stopping power when you need it.

The sophisticated gray exterior presents a refined appearance that stands out for its versatility and modern appeal. Body-color bumpers, heated power mirrors with turn signal indicators, and power windows create a cohesive and contemporary design that makes a statement wherever you go.

This 2024 Mazda Mazda3 2.5 S Carbon Edition is ready for your test drive and ready to enhance your daily driving experience. Visit our showroom today to see how this vehicle combines style, capability, and thoughtful engineering into one compelling package.

Meet this sharp 2024 Nissan Sentra SV sedan, finished in gray with a charcoal interior. This fuel-efficient model delivers 30 mpg in the city and 40 mpg on the highway, making it perfect for daily commuting. Recently serviced with a fresh oil change and fully detailed, this Sentra is ready to impress.

- Android Auto and Apple CarPlay connectivity
- Bluetooth audio streaming
- Backup camera for confident parking
- 2.0L I4 DOHC engine with CVT transmission
- Blind Spot Warning system
- Electronic Stability Control and Traction Control
- Auto High-beam Headlights
- Rear Parking Sensors
- Air Conditioning with rear window defroster
- 16" Alloy Wheels

This Sentra combines reliable performance with modern conveniences you'll use every day. Stop by to see this well-maintained sedan in person and take a test drive.
